items.reason: A lightweight hydrating serum that plumps skin so fine lines look softer, without being heavy on oily skin.
A light ceramide moisturizer that supports a comfortable, balanced-looking barrier for oily, sensitive-feeling skin.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection, which helps keep fine lines from looking more pronounced.

response.routine_note: We removed the Retinol 0.3% Night Serum (LL-106) because retinol is not advised during pregnancy, so this gentle routine is a pregnancy-friendly way to support the look of fine lines, and it is worth checking any other active products with your prenatal provider. Use the hydrating serum then moisturizer morning and night, and finish with the mineral SPF each morning.
